view_issues: The Summary says high-impact chronic pain is higher among bisexual adults, but the crude rate (6.3%) is below the rate for straight adults (6.9%). The age-adjusted CIs (6.6–13.1 vs 5.9–6.6) nearly overlap. The 2016 comparisons in the Discussion are stated without a test.
